rows.grounds: compound indicating one-and-a-half parts as a proportional measure
compound indicating a single part as a proportional measure
first member of compound denoting the wall
subject denoting the breadth or extent of the wall

items.question: What proportional measures are permitted for the extent of the wall?
premises: The wall extent may measure one-and-a-half parts.
The wall extent may measure one part.
The wall extent may be equal in measure.
items.inference: The extent of the wall is permitted in alternative proportions of one-and-a-half parts, one part, or equal measure.
items.plain_english: The extent of the wall may be one-and-a-half parts, one part, or equal.
